theorem.name: TwoE8StromingerSelectionTypingRepairTheorem
theorem.statement: Replacing the single gauge connection by (A1,A2) and summing both Chern-Simons, Bianchi and Yang-Mills terms gives the correctly typed E8xE8 functional. Its Euler-Lagrange and local convexity arguments extend blockwise under the same gap hypotheses for both bundles.
